newsitem.title: UK: Mammograms could lead to suicide, doctors warn.
newsitem.headline: Mammograms could lead to suicide, doctors warn.

text.p: Two British women may have committed suicide because of positive mammograms showing they had breast cancer, British doctors warned on Friday.

One had a mastectomy in 1986 and killed herself soon after. Her suicide note was written on a letter concerning the cancer operation, Dr Jeremy Hawker and Dr John Weil of the Birmingham Health Authority said in a letter to the British Medical Journal.
The second left a note speaking of her fear of admission to hospital. Both had children who had died of cancer, Hawker and Weil said after scrutinising coroner's records in Birmingham.
"To our knowledge this is the first report suggesting that adverse psychological effects of mammography might also include death," they wrote.
